items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, on what basis do you hire -- like you just hired a bass player, right. John Clinton. [INTERVIEWEE] Clayton.

ctx.x: Well, Pete Deke Johnson and Albert Ammons, 'Luxe' Lewis and Luck Liz and (inaudible) -- he played "Honky Tonk Train," what's his name, can't think of the name of it, but I think he would be mentioned in there, because he's made "Honky Tonk Train." (inaudible).
Well, on what basis do you hire -- like you just hired a bass player, right. John Clinton.
